title: Swan and ArabicMTEB: Dialect-Aware, Arabic-Centric, Cross-Lingual, and Cross-Cultural Embedding Models and Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and benchmarking text embedding models (Swan) for Arabic dialects and culture across standard NLP tasks like retrieval and classification. It includes a mandatory Ethical Statement on societal implications, but evaluating religion, morals, or ethics is not a component of the research or its benchmarks.
